name: veterinary_clinic_system_023_late_fee_assessment
instruction: Finance is assessing late fees. The percentage for THIS episode is stored in veterinary_clinic_system_ops_meta.late_fee_pct (an integer percent). For every invoice with status 'overdue' (after you apply the re-flagging rule: 'sent' with due_date strictly before the episode date becomes 'overdue') and unpaid balance, add a late fee: append a line item {description: 'Late fee (<pct>% of overdue balance)', quantity: 1, unit_price: <round(pct% * unpaid, 2)>} to that invoice, increase total_amount by the same amount, and increase the owner's balance by the same amount. Apply each invoice's fee once. Paid and draft invoices are never touched.

success_criteria.summary: Read late_fee_pct from ops_meta. Compute expected overdue set (sent with due<ep plus already-overdue) from snapshot. For each: assert status 'overdue', line_items == snapshot items + 1 with exact fee (cents), total == snapshot total + fee, and owner.balance == snapshot balance + sum of that owner's fees. Assert all other invoices/owners byte-identical.

checks.expect: Read late_fee_pct from ops_meta. Compute expected overdue set (sent with due<ep plus already-overdue) from snapshot. For each: assert status 'overdue', line_items == snapshot items + 1 with exact fee
